form.label: Mortgage Platform: Service Health (M9)
form.description: Request rate, 5xx rate, payment latency and the payment SLI from the http_request log line of all four services; errors and consumer failures from the log contract (docs/operations/observability.md). SLOs: docs/operations/slo.md

search.query: index=mortgage_dev message=http_request service.name=mortgage-service http.method=POST http.route="/api/v1/mortgages/{id}/payments" | eval good=if('http.status'<500,1,0) | stats count as total, sum(good) as good | eval sli=if(total>0, round(good/total*100,2), null()) | fields sli
index=mortgage_dev message=http_request service.name=mortgage-service http.method=POST http.route="/api/v1/mortgages/{id}/payments" | stats perc95(durationMs) as p95 | eval p95=round(p95,1)

panel.title: Request rate by service (requests per minute)

search.query: index=mortgage_dev message=http_request | timechart span=1m count by service.name
index=mortgage_dev message=http_request | eval is_5xx=if('http.status'>=500,100,0) | timechart span=5m avg(is_5xx) by service.name

index=mortgage_dev message=http_request service.name=mortgage-service http.method=POST http.route="/api/v1/mortgages/{id}/payments" | timechart span=5m perc50(durationMs) as p50, perc95(durationMs) as p95, max(durationMs) as max

panel.title: Event consumer failures (retried; dead-lettered after 3 receives)

search.query: index=mortgage_dev (log.logger="com.capstone.servicing.service.EventConsumerService" OR log.logger="src.messaging.event_consumer" OR log.logger="src.messaging.bootstrap") (log.level=WARN OR log.level=ERROR) | timechart span=5m count by service.name

panel.title: Latest errors (click a correlationId to follow the request)

search.query: index=mortgage_dev log.level=ERROR | table _time service.name correlationId log.logger message error.type | head 20
